selection: all six V9 xyz development candidate pairs including four rejected cases; no desk/room/teddy rerun
fit_split: original source-feature-row even IDs; odd IDs are validation; do not use original inlier mask to select fit rows
primary: matched raw-frame-pose initialization for both models on every pair; failed or skipped solves fully roll back and stay failures
secondary: matched frozen RANSAC 3D-3D initialization for both models only when an existing model is available; report all, never select best after GT
solver: SciPy trf 3-point numerical Jacobian, same 6-DoF local rotation and additive translation, block Huber delta2, max100 evaluations, strict convergence and finite cost/depth/Jacobian checks; no novel solver claim
model_units: 3D-3D Euclidean blocks /0.01m; 3D-2D pixel blocks /2px; these noise scales are fixed and imply different objectives, not equal physical weights
truth_use: fit-only finalized before GT opens; nearest and bracketed interpolation only evaluation, no truth-driven fit/selection
continuation_criteria: development evidence only: >=2 primary pairs with both models converged, 3D-2D meeting <=3cm/2deg in both time protocols and gaining >=5mm and10% translation with <=0.5deg rotation loss OR >=0.5deg and10% rotation with <=5mm translation loss; paired primary medians must not worsen >5mm/0.5deg; no extra 3D-2D solver failures. Passing permits proposing a newly frozen validation, not a trajectory/online claim. Failure stops this fixed comparison without tuning.
limitations: previously seen development pairs; not fresh independent test
both arms use original target-depth-valid eligibility so target depth remains a selection dependency
no new RANSAC or matching; common raw initialization can fail on poor correspondences
3D-3D initialization is a secondary bias control, not ground-truth model selection
no map, BA, trajectory, risk scheduling or online changes
